findings.title: reasoning_effort rejects "minimal", a valid value for the GPT-5 models this fix targets.
findings.body: The linked issue is about gpt-5 models, which accept `reasoning_effort="minimal"`. This Pydantic field only allows `Literal["low", "medium", "high"]`, so `ChatCompletionClient.load_component` with `"reasoning_effort": "minimal"` raises a ValidationError, and that setting still can't be used. The TypedDict on line 53 has the same restriction, so type checkers reject it too. The PR description says `"minimal"` is included, but the diff doesn't add it. Fix: use `Literal["minimal", "low", "medium", "high"]` in both the `CreateArguments` TypedDict and `CreateArgumentsConfigModel`, and add `"minimal"` to the valid values in the test.
